# Environment variables intentionally left out of the user-facing docs.
#
# The CI check `scripts/check-new-env-vars-documented.sh` fails when a variable
# newly added to `.env.sample` is not documented under `docs/docs/`. If a new
# variable is a purely internal tuning knob that must NOT appear in the
# user-facing documentation, add its exact name here (one per line) to exempt it.
#
# Prefer documenting the variable over allow-listing it. Existing undocumented
# variables do not need to be listed — only *newly added* variables are checked.
#
# Example:
# SOME_INTERNAL_ONLY_VARIABLE
